Title: Python Inheritance
Description: Inheritance allows us to define a class that inherits all the methods and properties from another class.

Challenges.Title: Parent class
Challenges.Exercise: Create a class `Person` with a printname method.

Challenges.Title: Child class
Challenges.Exercise: Create a class `Student` that inherits from `Person`.

Challenges.Title: Add init
Challenges.Exercise: Add an `__init__()` function to the `Student` class.

Challenges.Title: Super function
Challenges.Exercise: Use the `super()` function inside the Student's init.

Challenges.Title: Add properties
Challenges.Exercise: Add a property called `graduationyear` to the `Student` class.
